long_biography.plain_text:
Zaccardelli earned a doctorate in pharmacy at Michigan, then completed a clinical-research fellowship at the University of North Carolina and Burroughs Wellcome. He remained in clinical research at Burroughs Wellcome and Glaxo Wellcome before creating a contract-research startup. Twelve years at United Therapeutics took him from development and manufacturing responsibilities to chief operating officer.

Successive chief-executive appointments taught him to steer medicines and organisations through complex transitions. At Verona, he concentrated that experience on ensifentrine, guiding the programme through two pivotal studies and its first regulatory approval. The resulting treatment reached patients under the name Ohtuvayre, moving the company from development into commercial operation. Merck's 2025 acquisition closed that chapter and left Zaccardelli applying the same experience as a director, chairman and life-sciences investor.
